data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as it ends.

**Target:** A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH** unit of yours that is not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy units. Or, if you spend a [Flux token](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.scintillating-legion.fates-in-flux) as you use this Stratagem, up to 2 **LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH** units of yours instead, including ones in Engagement Range of enemy units.

**Effect:** Take the units off the battlefield and put them in [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves).
